missingInfo.question: Should the sync run one way (Northgate to the platform) or both ways?
missingInfo.why: The email says both ways; the call mostly described a one-way pull. Two-way roughly doubles the build and testing.

missingInfo.question: Does Tidewell’s Northgate contract include the REST API, or only nightly SFTP files?
missingInfo.why: Decides the connector design and how fresh the data can be.

missingInfo.question: Can you request Northgate sandbox access this week? It usually takes two weeks.
missingInfo.why: Without a sandbox, integration testing can’t start.

missingInfo.question: When the same field changes on both sides, which system should win?
missingInfo.why: Conflict rules decide how much reconciliation logic is needed.

missingInfo.question: Should the first run reconcile all ~1,200 existing records, or only new changes?
missingInfo.why: A full backfill adds a reconciliation pass and clean-up of known duplicates.

ask.question: Why is the range so wide?
ask.answer: The work is 392h at P50 and 465h at P80. 5 questions are still open, and each one widens the items it touches. The biggest is “Does Tidewell’s Northgate contract include the REST API, or only nightly SFTP files?”: answering it narrows the range by about 9h.

ask.question: What if we add another engineer?
ask.answer: With 3 engineers instead of 2, the P50 finish moves from 2027-01-15 to 2027-01-08, and the chance of meeting 2026-12-18 goes from 2% to 8%. Total effort rises slightly, from 392h to 422h, because each extra person adds coordination time.

ask.question: Which question should I ask the client first?
ask.answer: Ask “Does Tidewell’s Northgate contract include the REST API, or only nightly SFTP files?” first. It narrows the range by about 9h, more than any other open question. Next is “Should the sync run one way (Northgate to the platform) or both ways?” (~7h).

ask.question: How was the buffer calculated?
ask.answer: The buffer is 86h, in three parts. Task risk is 23h: the root-square of each item's P80−P50 gap. Open questions add 38h, and absence adds 25h (7% of P50 hours). Committing to ΣP50 + buffer gives 443h, landing on 2027-01-26.
